moments.description: A blank black screen is displayed.
The TodoMVC app loads with the header "todos" and an empty text input placeholder reading "What needs to be done?".
"Buy milk" is added to the list, with the counter displaying "1 item left" and filter options "All", "Active", and "Completed" visible.
"Finish the hackathon demo video" is added to the list above "Buy milk", and the counter updates to "2 items left".
"Call mom" is added to the top of the list, and the counter displays "3 items left".
"Fix login bug" is added to the list, showing four items total and a footer counter showing "4 items left".
The four items "Fix login bug", "Call mom", "Finish the hackathon demo video", and "Buy milk" remain displayed in the list while the mouse cursor moves around the screen.
The checkbox for "Fix login bug" is checked and strikethrough styling is applied; the counter reads "3 items left" and "Clear completed" appears.
"Finish the hackathon demo video" is checked and struck through, and the footer counter updates to "2 items left".
The "Active" filter is selected, showing only the active items "Call mom" and "Buy milk", with the counter displaying "2 items left".
The "Completed" filter is selected, showing only the checked items "Fix login bug" and "Finish the hackathon demo video".
The "All" filter is selected, showing all items: checked "Fix login bug", unchecked "Call mom", checked "Finish the hackathon demo video", and unchecked "Buy milk".
The "All" filter remains selected with all four items visible and "2 items left" in the footer as the cursor hovers over the "Completed" button.
